audience: shop and café owners who run their sales, stock and customers in Elementary POS

useCases.title: Review sales by cash register for a day
useCases.text: List the receipts for a date range or one cash register. Open one receipt to read its items, totals and cashier.

useCases.title: Check which items are low on stock
useCases.text: Read the stock quantity of each SKU, with the low-stock flag. List the stock changes since your last sync to see recent movements.

useCases.title: Follow open bills and the cash drawer
useCases.text: List the open bills on the cash registers now and open one to see its total and customer. Read the cash journal to see who added or removed cash.

useCases.title: Update a customer's contact details
useCases.text: List the customers and open one to read its details and loyalty points. Then change its e-mail, phone or note.

useCases.title: Record a stock delivery or write-off
useCases.text: Add a stock change for one SKU. Use a positive quantity for a delivery and a negative one for a write-off. Use a new request ID for each change.
